responsibility: Implements the tiny C-callable allocation and mutation bridge for gccrs’s Polonius FFI container types. This file provides the exported constructors and push helpers for FFI::FFIVector<size_t>, vector-of-pairs, and vector-of-triples declared in the Polonius interface, so GCC C++ code can build fact payload containers in the exact ABI form expected by the external Rust Polonius engine without exposing C++ templates across the language boundary.
same_name_distinction: Within the rust-polonius pair, this .cc file provides the out-of-line executable FFI bridge functions—constructors and push helpers for ABI-safe vector containers—whereas rust-polonius.h defines the Polonius-facing C++ types, fact storage/view helpers, point decoding utilities, and external engine interface declarations.
